key_insight: IteraSim RAG improves OpenFOAM case generation by combining query expansion, hybrid retrieval, and a multi-agent writer/reviewer workflow instead of relying on a single flat RAG pass.
engineering_relevance: This lowers the barrier to setting up physically consistent CFD input decks, which is valuable for non-specialists and for faster iteration on turbulence and boundary-condition workflows.
method: LLM expands each user request into physics, solver-keyword, and troubleshooting queries
Reciprocal Rank Fusion merges ranked results, then MMR re-ranks candidates from an HNSW dense vector store
A keyword router and three agents—Architect, InputWriter, Reviewer—split generation and repair tasks with a canonical knowledge layer
evidence_signal: On an openly released 28-case benchmark, the system achieved 77.9% mean retrieval coverage (79.1% median), exceeded 90% in parameter-modification cases, and completed all six reference OpenFOAM v2506 runs.
watch_item: Performance depends on curated canonical knowledge and bounded reviewer loops, so edge cases outside the benchmark may still require expert oversight.
paper_title: IteraSim RAG: A Multi-Stage Retrieval-Augmented Agentic Back-End for OpenFOAM-Based Computational Fluid Dynamics
